crossRefs.note: For the saying which he cried by Yahweh’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high…
He sought Ahaziah, and they caught him (now he was hiding in Samaria), and they brought him to Jehu, and killed him…

people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Naboth
people.line: Jezreelite vineyard owner, unjustly killed by Ahab and Jezebel.

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: “Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.
translations.bsb: “Get up and go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who is in Samaria. See, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone to take possession of it.
translations.kjv: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which is in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.
translations.asv: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwelleth in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to take possession of it.
